title: Failed release deploy + rollback (EN, build logs, node version root cause)

content.text: The v3.8.2 release deploy to production failed twenty minutes ago and the API pods are crash-looping. Can you dig in? We rolled the frontend already but the API is still on the broken image.
Pulling the deploy pipeline log for the v3.8.2 API image first.

Job build-api #1874: SUCCESS (image sha256:9f31c2 pushed). Job deploy-prod #1875: pods enter CrashLoopBackOff. Container log tail:

  node: --experimental-require-module is not allowed in NODE_OPTIONS
  error: exit 9

Base image in Dockerfile: node:22.7.0-alpine (bumped in commit 41ac9de "chore: bump base images"). Previous release v3.8.1 used node:22.5.1-alpine.

Full build log:

Root cause found: commit 41ac9de bumped the base image to node:22.7.0-alpine, and 22.7.0 removed --experimental-require-module from the allowed NODE_OPTIONS list. Our production manifest still injects that flag via NODE_OPTIONS (it was needed for 22.5), so every pod exits with code 9 before the app even starts. The build succeeded because the flag is only applied at runtime.

Immediate mitigation: roll the API back to v3.8.1. Then we fix forward by dropping the flag from the manifest instead of pinning the old node.

Rollback executed: prod-api now serving v3.8.1 (image sha256:77aa10). 12/12 pods Ready in 94s. Health endpoint /api/health returns 200. Error rate back to baseline 0.02%.

Rollout events:

Production is stable again on v3.8.1 — 12/12 pods ready, health green, error rate at baseline. Now the forward fix. The clean solution is removing --experimental-require-module from NODE_OPTIONS in the prod manifest (deploy/manifests/prod-api.yaml line 47): since node 22.6 the require(esm) path is enabled by default, so the flag is dead weight and now actively fatal. I will also add a boot smoke test to the pipeline so a runtime-only failure like this fails the PIPELINE, not production.
Agreed on both. One more thing — was ist eigentlich mit dem Cronjob fuer die Report-Generierung? Der lief auch auf dem neuen Image, hat der auch gecrasht?

report-cron runs: 02:00 UTC run on v3.8.1 image = SUCCESS (before the deploy). 08:00 UTC run scheduled AFTER the v3.8.2 deploy = FAILED with the same exit 9. 3 retries, all failed. The 08:00 daily revenue report was NOT generated or sent.

Cron history:

Ja — der 08:00-UTC-Lauf des report-cron ist mit demselben exit 9 gescheitert, drei Retries erfolglos. Der Tagesumsatz-Report von heute wurde also nicht erzeugt und nicht versendet. Nach dem Rollback laeuft der Cron wieder auf v3.8.1; ich habe den 08:00-Lauf manuell nachgeholt — Report ist raus, Empfaenger wie immer.

Summary of the incident and the plan:
- Root cause: node:22.7.0 bump (commit 41ac9de) + stale NODE_OPTIONS flag --experimental-require-module → exit 9 crash loop.
- Mitigation done: API rolled back to v3.8.1, 08:00 report re-run manually.
- Fix forward (owner: me): PR removing the flag from deploy/manifests/prod-api.yaml line 47, plus a pipeline boot smoke test that starts the container with prod NODE_OPTIONS before any deploy.
- Release v3.8.3 will carry the fix; v3.8.2 is abandoned, do not redeploy it.
- Post-incident note goes into the runbook at /opt/acme/runbooks/deploy.md.
Good. Get the PR up today please, and put the incident timeline in the runbook before you forget the details. Ping me when the smoke test is green so I can approve the release.

Will do. Next steps in order: (1) PR with the manifest fix and the boot smoke test — today; (2) incident timeline into /opt/acme/runbooks/deploy.md; (3) ping you for approval once the smoke test is green, then cut v3.8.3. v3.8.2 stays quarantined.

rubric: States the root cause precisely: the node:22.7.0 base-image bump (commit 41ac9de) made the stale NODE_OPTIONS flag --experimental-require-module fatal (exit 9 crash loop).
Records that production was mitigated by rolling the API back to v3.8.1 and is stable.
Records the forward-fix decision: remove the flag from deploy/manifests/prod-api.yaml (not pin the old node) plus add a pipeline boot smoke test.
Preserves that the 08:00 UTC report-cron run failed with the same error and the daily revenue report was manually re-run afterwards.
Preserves that v3.8.2 is abandoned/quarantined and the fix ships as v3.8.3.
Keeps the open task: raise the fix PR today.
Keeps the open task: write the incident timeline into /opt/acme/runbooks/deploy.md.
Keeps the follow-up owed: ping the user for approval once the smoke test is green, before cutting v3.8.3.
